# Supanote

> > Supanote is a HIPAA-compliant AI platform that automates therapy note generation for mental health providers, enabling faster clinical documentation while maintaining full compliance and patient privacy.

Supanote serves mental health professionals including psychologists, therapists, and group practices by leveraging AI to streamline progress notes (SOAP, DAP, EMDR, PIE formats) and clinical documentation. The platform integrates with existing EHR systems and provides templates, worksheets, and billing resources to enhance therapist productivity.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA Compliance
- AI Therapy Notes
- Clinical Documentation
- Progress Notes (SOAP/DAP/EMDR/PIE)
- Mental Health Software
- EHR Integration
- Automated Note Generation
- Therapist Productivity
- CPT Billing Codes
- DBT & IFS Worksheets
- Telehealth Compatible
- Usage-Based Pricing
- GDPR & SOC 2 Certified
- Group Practice Tools
- Clinical Notes Templates
